    import inspect
    # candidate_fn is the class or a factory; try instantiating it
    try:
        cache = candidate_fn(2)
    except TypeError:
        # Maybe candidate_fn IS already an instance; try calling the class found in the module
        raise AssertionError('LRU Cache class must accept capacity as first argument')
    cache.put(1, 1)
    cache.put(2, 2)
    assert cache.get(1) == 1, f'Expected 1, got {cache.get(1)}'
    cache.put(3, 3)
    assert cache.get(2) == -1, f'Expected eviction of 2, got {cache.get(2)}'
    cache.put(4, 4)
    assert cache.get(1) == -1, f'Expected eviction of 1, got {cache.get(1)}'
    assert cache.get(3) == 3, f'Expected 3, got {cache.get(3)}'
